literal_meaning: থানা এবং পুলিশের সাথে জড়িয়ে পড়া (police station and police involvement)
figurative_meaning_en: To get entangled in legal cases or litigation
similar_in_english: To run afoul of the law
To get in hot water with the authorities
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসার লেনদেনে ভুল করে থানা-পুলিশ করতে হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He got involved with the police over a minor dispute.
A mistake in the business deal led to getting tangled in legal troubles.
note: This idiom reflects common experiences with the legal system in Bengali society.
